sections.description: Build curated, SEO-friendly blog home and archive pages with the WordPress block editor.
sections.changelog:
= 1.8.1 =
* Keep the archive picker open while choosing an archive and block area; close it only with OK, Continue, or dismissal.
* Show only areas belonging to the selected target, including an explicit choice for single-area templates.

= 1.8.0 =
* Set the page title to Blog Home when that archive target is selected.
* Offer new archive targets and areas only when their effective template contains a compatible Archive Page Content block.
* Add Blog Home and public post-type main archives as explicit editor targets.
* Space archive target, area, notices, and actions consistently in the editor sidebar.
* Support named areas, duplicate assignment validation, autosaves, and public links for the new targets.
* Preserve existing taxonomy connections and legacy filtered post-type archive pages.

= 1.7.0 =
* Make archive navigation controls and block insertion opt-in through `custom-archive-pages-navigation` theme support.
* Preserve saved navigation blocks and category selections when support is absent.
* Clarify that excluded categories hide navigation links, not recipes.
* Themes using archive navigation must declare support to retain category editing controls.

= 1.6.7 =
* Disable assigned terms with one area, or occupied areas for the selected term with multiple areas.
* Validate duplicate assignments on REST saves, including drafts and autosaves.

= 1.6.6 =
* Preserve archive term and content-area selections during native WordPress draft autosaves and revision restoration.

= 1.6.5 =
* Rename the dashboard menu and related editing labels to Archive Pages to reflect support for multiple taxonomies.

= 1.6.4 =
* Display the official Made to Thrive circle badge in WordPress plugin updates.

= 1.6.3 =
* Use the handwritten mtt mark for plugin update icons; retain the existing admin menu mark.

= 1.6.2 =
* Improve the template area name field with a wider input and help text underneath.

= 1.6.1 =
* Fix the editor crash caused by calling an internal block insertion selector.

= 1.6.0 =
* Add named template areas with independent term content and stable assignments.
* Keep the single-area workflow free of an extra selector.
* Include custom post type taxonomies and filter the admin list by post type and taxonomy.

= 1.5.0 =
* Add portable child-category navigation and category inclusion/exclusion controls.
* Share term resolution with archive-aware recipe grids and previews.
* Preserve the standard MTT update channel and existing archive editor features.

= 1.4.2 =
* Let editors dismiss the initial term chooser with its close button or Escape key.
* Allow drafts and autosaves without a term while preventing publish, schedule, or private publication until a valid term is selected.
* Add matching client-side guidance and server-side publish validation.

= 1.4.1 =
* Replace the Category Pages admin menu icon with the Made to Thrive brand mark.
* Size the SVG on a 20-pixel square canvas while preserving its original proportions.

= 1.4.0 =
* Establish the canonical Made to Thrive release and update channel.
* Combine the 1.3.0 archive-term fields and block bindings with the 1.2.6 paginated-archive option.
* Keep automatic updates disabled unless the agency explicitly opts in.
* Raise the maintained release line to WordPress 6.9 and PHP 8.1.

= 1.3.0 =
* Add the `mtt_archive_short_description` term field to taxonomy and Archive Page editing screens.
* Add the `custom-archive-pages/term-field` block binding source for archive taglines and recipe headings.
* Preserve category images when terms are updated through another editor workflow.

= 1.2.6 =
* Adds an opt-in setting for showing curated content on paginated archives.

= 1.2.5 =
* Exclude taxonomy terms already connected to another archive page from editor term options and searches.
* Keep the current archive page's connected term available while editing that page.

= 1.2.4 =
* Discover public UI taxonomies automatically, including Collections.
* Require both taxonomy type and term ID when resolving archive page content to avoid cross-taxonomy term ID collisions.
* Use taxonomy-neutral term selection copy in the block editor.

= 1.2.2 =
* Replace the block-editor connection summary with a core-style Category field.
* Add an Archive Page Content block setting for a specific taxonomy, with an “Any supported taxonomy” option for general archive templates.
* Add a native term editor modal for name, slug, and rich description links.
* Simplify editor copy and remove the visible “Searching terms” state.
* Keep the older metabox as a shorter fallback outside the block editor.

= 1.2.1 =
* Fix misleading “below” copy; clarify steps and “open live site archive” link (tooltip + new tab to the public URL)
* Unlock/sync term description without a full page reload: mousedown + Enter on search results, drop flaky `offsetParent` check, re-sync from editor meta and a DB fallback after save
* New AJAX helpers: term snapshot and saved metabox state for block editor sync

= 1.2.0 =
* Document sidebar panel (block editor) mirroring connection status; syncs when the Appears On metabox changes
* AJAX save for term description (debounced while typing, save on blur) without updating the whole post
* After picking a term: focus and scroll the description field, character count with SEO length hint
* Quick links: view public archive, edit term in WordPress admin
* Duplicate-term warning when another archive page already uses the same term
* `MutationObserver` so the metabox still initializes if it is injected late
* REST-registered connection meta (`connected_taxonomy`, `connected_*`) for integrations
* Filters/actions: `custom_archive_pages/term_description_for_editor`, `custom_archive_pages/term_description_saved`

= 1.1.0 =
* Removed ACF dependency, now uses native WordPress meta boxes
* Improved compatibility and performance

= 1.0.0 =
* Initial release
* Support for custom category pages
* Gutenberg block for archive templates
* Admin bar quick links
